release_notes:
Two Ready Messages log improvements.

1. Cap at 6 visible entries. The log now silently drops the oldest entry whenever a 7th would be added. Mouse-wheel scrollback is gone; the widget shows only the 6 most recent alerts. The cap applies at runtime (each send/receive trims immediately) and at startup (replayed entries from today's ready_log.txt are trimmed after reload so you never wake up to a wall of old rows). ready_log.txt itself is unaffected -- persistence is unchanged; only the on-screen display is capped.

2. Left-align log body text flush with the 'Ready Messages' heading. The body column was sitting ~12 px inside the left edge of the panel due to accumulated insets: a 2 px RoundedLogPanel canvas inset, a 6 px Text widget padx, and a 4 px tab-stop offset. All three are now zero so the body's left edge lands at the panel's content boundary, matching the visual left edge of the heading above it. The separator lines are adjusted in lockstep (padx 12 -> 8, width formula tab2_x - 20 -> tab2_x - 16) so they still span symmetrically between the body column and just inside the rightmost timestamp character.
